{{Top|leg}}
A '''Khanate''' was a military division within the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] military structure known as the [[Kolkpravis]]. The Kolkpravis itself consisted of only eight khanates each of which was led by one of the eight [[Khan/Legends|Khans]] who were collectively known as the [[Izvoshra/Legends|Izvoshra]]. Each khanate consisted of several [[Brigade (Kolkpravis)|brigades]] which were led by a [[Baatar]], which in turn consisted of one hundred [[horde]]s each led by [[Tarkhan]]s, which broke down to one hundred [[kamen]] each led by a [[Blackarm]]s.<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
